title: Greek Chicken Pasta Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful pasta bake filled with chicken, feta, and sun-dried tomatoes, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and basil. Grill or sauté until cooked through.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, chicken, feta cheese, and sun-dried tomatoes.
Drizzle with olive oil and toss to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional feta cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
